Emma (Partnerships): Heads-up: Meridian Pharmacy signed a 30-day Private pilot via GCP Marketplace. They want Redwood Private in their VPC for prescription transcription + entity extraction. Big ISV channel win with CloudBridge. :tada:
Omar (Sales): Great news. Offer ID GM-44011. Pilot billing via Marketplace Private Offer. Will push renewal/expansion targets after week 2.
Zoe (Eng): Tech checklist: deploy to their subnet, ensure Cloud KMS integration, and pin model versions. Requesting sample transcripts to size throughput.
Ravi (Customer Success): Onboarding kickoff set for Fri 2pm ET. Customer requested a short joint case study if metrics look good.
Casey (Marketing): Please capture logos and customer permission for quotes. I'll reserve a partner spotlight slot.
BotOps (bot): Ticket #PM-6012 created: "Meridian Pharmacy - GCP Marketplace Private pilot" (assignees: Zoe, Ravi, Emma).
Omar (Sales): Expansion KPIs: p95 < 90ms, throughput 200 qps @256 seq, extraction F1 > 0.9. Looping CloudBridge partner manager.
Zoe (Eng): I'll post a minimal deploy snippet and perf checklist in #eng-runtime. Need infra review for VPC firewall rules.
Emma (Partnerships): Shoutout to Omar and Ravi for moving fast. Keeping coordination here; reply with blockers. :rocket:
